tagline: The company designs and sells high-performance gaming and streaming peripherals, components and systems to enthusiasts globally.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI represents the components and gaming systems segment, which includes PCs and AI workstations. It is crucial because it shows the company's ability to capitalize on the growing market for high-performance PCs and AI workstations.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin measures the efficiency of product production and pricing.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in gross profitability, indicating better cost management or increased pricing power.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue after deductions for returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net revenue represents the total sales amount generated by the company.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth, demonstrating sustained demand for the company's products.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Total amount of losses incurred by the company after all expenses.
kpis.description: Net loss is the final financial result when expenses exceed revenues.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in net losses, indicating improvement in overall profitability.

kpis.name: Cash and Restricted Cash
kpis.explanation: Total amount of cash and assets easily convertible into cash.
kpis.description: Available cash is essential for day-to-day operations and strategic investments.
kpis.signal: Decline in cash balance, potentially due to investments or acquisitions.

kpis.short: Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities
kpis.name: Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's core business operations.
kpis.description: This cash flow indicates the company's ability to generate liquidity from its operations.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in operating cash flows, signaling improved operational efficiency.

kpis.name: New Products Launched
kpis.explanation: Number of new products introduced to the market during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Launching new products is a key indicator of the company's innovation and growth strategy.
kpis.signal: Significant launch of new products, signaling strong commitment to innovation and portfolio expansion.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.25 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.19 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Acquisition Fanatec
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Fanatec, a sim racing products brand, to strengthen Corsair's position in this market.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Fanatec aims to complement Corsair's existing offering in gaming and sim racing.
kpis.signal: Strategic acquisition to expand product portfolio and presence in the sim racing market.

risks.title: Unfavorable global macroeconomic conditions
risks.summary: Challenging global economic conditions, including inflation, high interest rates, increased tariffs since February 2025, and geopolitical tensions, may negatively impact consumer demand and supply chain operations.
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions 'challenging global macroeconomic conditions' (Item 7 MD&A). Challenges include inflation, high interest rates, substantial tariffs since February 2025, and geopolitical tensions (Ukraine, Middle East, Red Sea, China-Taiwan). The intensity of language and level of detail justify a high severity rating.

risks.title: Dependence on technological refresh cycles
risks.summary: Demand for the company's products, particularly gaming components and systems, is highly tied to the launch of new high-performance CPUs and GPUs, creating dependence on technology refresh cycles.
risks.score_rationale: The report emphasizes the introduction of new CPUs and GPUs as a key demand driver (Item 7 MD&A). The statement that 'demand moderated during 2024 as we entered into a mid-cycle period' and that 'demand in 2026 may be more consistent with mid-cycle conditions' indicates vulnerability to launch cycles.

risks.title: Intense competition in the gaming and content creation market
risks.summary: The market for gaming and creator products is highly competitive, requiring continuous investment in innovation, product launches (105 in 2025), and marketing to maintain a leading position.
risks.score_rationale: The general business description (Item 1 Business) states that 'our solution is the most comprehensive product suite among our key competitors,' implying strong competition. The need to maintain leadership through continuous innovation justifies a high severity rating.

risks.title: Global supply chain risks and volatile tariffs
risks.summary: Potential disruptions to the global supply chain and significant increases in tariffs since February 2025 (Taiwan, China, Vietnam) impact production costs and product availability. Although Corsair has a flexible, multi-location manufacturing base, the environment remains volatile and unpredictable.
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A (Item 7) explicitly details challenges: 'Since February 2025, the U.S. government has proposed and in certain cases implemented new, substantial tariffs on imports to the United States from various countries, including Taiwan, China and Vietnam, where we manufacture or source our products'. Corsair also notes that 'while we mitigated the impact of new tariffs on our business to some extent during the year ended December 31, 2025, there can be no assurances that we will continue to be as effective'. High severity is justified by uncertainty and direct impacts.

risks.title: Global semiconductor supply constraints and rising DRAM prices
risks.summary: Global semiconductor supply constraints, amplified by demand for AI infrastructure, have led to a substantial increase in DRAM module costs. This creates a barrier to entry for the budget segment of the DIY PC market, but the impact on Corsair's core enthusiast segment is limited.
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A (Item 7) states: 'We are currently observing significant constraints in the global supply of semiconductors driven by the proliferation of AI infrastructure, which are materially impacting the broader hardware market.' It specifies that 'Heightened demand for these components has driven commodity prices to high levels, resulting in a substantial increase in the market price of DRAM modules'. Corsair notes, however, that 'our core market position is centered on the enthusiast-level PC builder, a demographic that historically demonstrates less price sensitivity than the broader market', which mitigates the impact.

ai_positioning.summary: The company did not mention AI, artificial intelligence, or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K report. Therefore, its positioning on these technologies is not evident from this information.
